Quantum 1.12.0 was certified on 2026-08-16. It pins **nucleus v1.8.0**, **quark v1.5.0** and **orbit v1.6.1**, with 5 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.11.0: nucleus goes from v1.7.0 to v1.8.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.4.1 to v1.5.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.5.4 to v1.6.1 (minor). 5 sibling modules change version.
